validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real. Two independent Egyptian outlets, on different dates, describe a specific ~10km/24in Borg El Arab gas line: (1) youm7.com (2021-01-21, an official Petroleum Ministry/EGAS project-status report titled 'details of national natural gas network projects underway') lists a table row 'خط برج العرب / ميدور بطول 10 كم – قطر 24"' (Borg El Arab/Midor line, 10km, 24-inch) with cost 120 million EGP and a March-2021 completion target -- an EXACT match to GEM's current Length=10.00km, Diameter=24in, SegmentCost=120,000,000 EGP, and consistent with StartYear1=2021. (2) elwatannews.com (2021-10-20, a New Alamein City Authority housing-project update) independently corroborates: it describes the main Al-Ameriya–New Alamein trunk (120km/32in, EGP 2bn -- this is very likely GEM's own P3931 'Amriya–El Alamein Gas Pipeline', recorded there as 130km/32in, a plausible re-measurement/segmentation difference) and states the project 'includes branches for the new Borg El Arab gas line, 10km long, 24-inch diameter, to secure the natural gas network and meet the needs of Alexandria governorate and the northwest coast' -- again 10km/24in, matching exactly, from a wholly different source, context (housing authority vs. petroleum ministry) and date. Two independent sources agreeing on length+diameter = tier high for those two fields; SegmentCost/StartYear are corroborated by only the youm7 source alone (tier medium for those). CLASSIFICATION: reasonable as transmission -- both sources frame this as part of Egypt's national natural-gas-grid (الشبكة القومية للفاز الطبيعي) expansion program, alongside other trunk/lateral projects (West Cairo power-station supply line, El-Alamein expansion, Tina West/Mit Nama/Sharkawiya) -- not a plant-internal or gathering line. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of any other roster row -- its 10km/24in spec is unique among the 51 Egypt gas operating rows reviewed. It IS a branch/lateral off the same corridor as P3931 (Amriya–El Alamein, 130km/32in) per the elwatannews source's own framing ('the project includes branches for...the new Borg El Arab gas line') -- flagging this parent/child relationship for awareness, not recommending a merge, since it is a physically distinct 10km spur with its own specs, not an overlapping re-entry of the trunk itself. Petrojet's cited page (petrojet.com.eg/news-details/15036) could NOT be verified -- it is a JS-rendered SPA that serves only a navigation shell to both curl and a rendering fetch; no article text is retrievable, so it is neither confirmed nor contradicted and should not be relied on (existing gem.wiki citation, not proposed here).

validity.researcher_notes: Two separable issues found: (1) NAME/ENDPOINT MISMATCH -- GEM's own current sheet records StartLocation='Borg El Arab', EndLocation='Al ameryia', but the pipeline's own name references 'Midor' (the MIDOR/Middle East Oil Refinery) as if it were an endpoint, and neither field says 'Midor'. Of the two corroborating sources, only youm7 names 'Midor' explicitly (as a label in a project table, without further description); elwatannews describes the same 10km/24in spur without naming Midor at all, instead framing it as a distribution branch 'to meet the needs of Alexandria governorate and the northwest coast' -- a materially different characterization (city/network gas supply vs. a dedicated refinery feed) than 'a line to Midor' implies. (2) GEOGRAPHIC PLAUSIBILITY -- independently sourced coordinates put MIDOR refinery at approx. 31.0983N, 29.86311E (Global Energy Observatory geoid/6809, in the Amreya/Dekheila west-Alexandria industrial belt), whereas the well-known town/new city of 'Borg El Arab' (New Borg El Arab, en.wikipedia.org) sits roughly 25-30km further southwest/inland (~30.90-31.00N, 29.53-29.72E). A straight line between those two reference points is roughly 25-30km, not the ~10km the pipeline is recorded (and independently corroborated) as being. Either (a) 'Borg El Arab' in this pipeline's name/StartLocation refers to a nearer tie-in point within the same west-Alexandria industrial corridor as MIDOR/Amreya (plausible -- 'Borg El Arab' is also a large administrative qism/markaz of Alexandria Governorate that extends along the coast, not just the distant new city+airport), or (b) the 10km length is only the length of a short lateral tapping off the larger Amriya-El Alamein trunk near Borg El Arab, not a line spanning the whole Ameriya-to-Borg-El-Arab distance. Neither source disambiguates which reading is correct, so I am not proposing new Location values or asserting fabricated coordinates -- flagging for a human to resolve with a facility-level source (e.g., a MIDOR company disclosure or GASCO network map) if one becomes available. This does not undermine the length/diameter/cost corroboration in the companion validity entry, which held regardless of exactly which 'Borg El Arab' reference point is meant.

I cannot defend a specific corridor line or a start coordinate without fabricating one; the tightest honest bound is 'somewhere in the Amreya/Dekheila/west-Alexandria industrial strip, within ~10km of the MIDOR refinery area.'
